shots.content: Inside a café, a rectangular table stands beside the window, with a tall floor plant near one end and the counter beyond the other. A woman in a mustard sweater sits in the plant-side window seat recounting a personal mishap, a man in a navy jacket sits in the counter-side window seat, a woman in a burgundy cardigan sits in the plant-side aisle seat, and a man in an emerald hoodie sits in the counter-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the counter end, looking lengthwise along the rectangular table toward the floor plant, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

shots.content: The man in the navy jacket asks the woman in the mustard sweater for clarification.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in the mustard sweater delivers the outcome to the man in the navy jacket, and the woman in the burgundy cardigan replies.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the rectangular table, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.
